defs.def: to make an opening or a wound in sth, especially with a sharp tool such as a knife or scissors 切；割；割破；划破
to remove sth or a part of sth, using a knife, etc. （用刀等从某物上）切下，割下

ex.s: Consider the following: • key action in each part of the story – is there anything you will cut from the original?
ex.t: 考虑以下几点：故事各部分的关键动作——有没有什么你要从原故事中删掉的内容？

defs.def: to make or form sth by removing material with a knife, etc. 切成；割成；剪成；削成；凿成
to divide sth into two or more pieces with a knife, etc. （用刀等将某物）切成，割成

ex.s: First I cut the tomatoes into pieces but put them aside.
ex.t: 首先我把西红柿切成块，但把它们放在一边。

ex.s: Rita cuts in: “We spoke more with Nick because I think it’s a big thing for Nick to live with his mother-in-law.”
ex.t: 丽塔插话道：“我们和尼克谈得更多，因为我觉得对尼克来说，和岳母同住是件大事。”

defs.def: to make sth shorter by cutting 剪短；修剪

ex.s: Cutting of Big Trees to Be Prohibited in California Soon
ex.t: 加州即将禁止砍伐大树

defs.def: to allow sb to escape from somewhere by cutting the rope, object, etc. that is holding them （割断绳子、某物等）让逃跑，释放
to design and make a piece of clothing in a particular way 剪裁
to be capable of cutting 可用于切割；能切割

ex.s: Volunteers will wash, cut, and freeze or dry them for use in meals down the road.
ex.t: 志愿者们会将它们清洗、切块、冷冻或干燥，以便日后用于餐食中。

ex.s: Campers learn technical skills of roasting, frying and cutting, as well as some recipes that they can take home and share with their families.
ex.t: 营员们学习烘烤、煎炸和切割等技术技能，以及一些可以带回家与家人分享的食谱。

defs.def: to be capable of being cut 可被切割

ex.s: To cut production costs.
ex.t: 为了降低生产成本。

ex.s: create new materialsB. cut down on waste
ex.t: 建立社交平台D. 推广语言学习

ex.s: What does the man want to cut out of paper?
ex.t: 这位男士想剪纸做什么？

ex.s: You'd better not have your hair cut during the Spring Festival month.
ex.t: 春节期间最好不要剪头发。

defs.def: to reduce sth by removing a part of it 削减；缩减；裁减

ex.s: How to cut his travel expenses.
ex.t: 如何削减他的差旅费用。

defs.def: to remove sth from sth 删剪；删节
to delete (= remove) part of a text on a computer screen in order to place it somewhere else 剪切
（让人停止做某事）
to completely end a relationship or all communication with sb 断绝（关系）；终止（沟通）
to prepare a film/movie or tape by removing parts of it or putting them in a different order 剪辑；剪接
to stop filming or recording 通常用于指令
to move quickly from one scene to another 电影、无线电广播或电视

ex.s: They found that more on-demand entertainment viewing on tablets instead of TVs and desktop computers could cut energy consumption by 44%.
ex.t: 他们发现，更多在平板电脑上而不是电视和台式电脑上进行按需娱乐观看可以将能耗降低44%。

defs.def: to stay away from a class that you should go to 旷（课）；缺（课）；逃学
to hurt sb emotionally （从感情上）伤害
to lift and turn up a pack/deck of playing cards in order to decide who is to play first, etc. （为决定谁先出牌等）切牌，抽牌
to cross another line 一条线
to have a new tooth beginning to appear through the gum 开始长（新牙）
to make a recording of music on a record, CD, etc. 灌制（唱片）；制作（激光唱片等）
to mix an illegal drug such as heroin with another substance 把（海洛因等）与另一种物质掺和

ex.s: Finning is a type of fishing where sharks are caught and their fins cut off.
ex.t: 芬宁(芬宁語：Finning)是一种捕鲨和割去鱼鳍的钓鱼方式。

ex.s: It prevents people who are cut off from society falling victim to cheaters.
ex.t: 这项努力不仅是一种社区意识的表现——它也是一项预防措施。

ex.s: They cut down trees and use chemicals that kill the plants that monarch caterpillars eat.
ex.t: 他们砍伐树木，使用杀死帝王蝶毛虫所依赖植物的化学物质。

defs.def: to affect or be true for different groups that usually remain separate 影响，符合，适用于（分离的不同群体）
to go across sth in order to make your route shorter 抄近路穿过；走近路
to reduce sth 减少；削减；缩减

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.
ex.t: 通过在添加一层岩盐之前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能能将其岩盐使用量减少30%。

ex.s: They cut down on their production.
ex.t: 它们降低了产品的含糖量。

ex.s: To cut the cost of e-space protection.
ex.t: 降低网络安全保护成本。

defs.def: to make a bush, etc. smaller by cutting branches off 剪枝；修剪
if a motor or an engine cuts in, it starts working （马达或发动机）发动

ex.s: It cuts the farm-to-table distance.
ex.t: 它缩短了从农场到餐桌的距离。

defs.def: to go in front of other people who are waiting 加塞儿；插队
to interrupt sb when they are speaking 打断（谈话）；插嘴

ex.s: It might seem unkind to cut people short when they interrupt you
ex.t: 当别人打断你时，打断对方的话可能显得不太友善

ex.s: It might seem unkind to cut people short when they interrupt you
ex.t: 当别人打断你时，打断对方的话可能显得不太友善

ex.s: When the Japanese cut open his body, they discovered only tree bark, cotton and grass roots, but not a single grain of rice in his stomach.
ex.t: 当日本人剖开他的身体时，发现里面只有树皮、棉花和草根，胃里连一粒米都没有。

defs.def: to move suddenly in front of another vehicle, leaving little space between the two vehicles 车辆或驾驶者
to interrupt sb who is speaking on the telephone by breaking the connection 中断（电话通话）
to refuse to let sb receive any of your property after you die 剥夺继承权
to interrupt sb and stop them from speaking 打断（某人并阻止其讲话）
to stop the supply of sth to sb 停止，中断（供给）

ex.s: “We’re not going to go cutting down any big old oaks,” and neither will the department completely stop planting new ones, said Auyeung.
ex.t: “我们不会去砍任何一棵高大的老橡树，”Auyeung说，管理局也不会完全停止种植新树。

defs.def: to remove sth from sth larger by cutting 切掉；割掉；砍掉；剪掉
to block or get in the way of sth 阻碍；阻挡；堵塞
to make sth by cutting 裁剪
to leave sth out of a piece of writing, etc. 删除；删去
（让人停止做或说恼人的事）住口，打住
to block sth, especially light 阻挡（尤指光线）
to remove sth from sth larger by cutting, usually with scissors （通常用剪刀）剪下

ex.s: Cut out pictures to help your preschool and kindergarten children learn their alphabet, numbers, and colors.
ex.t: 剪下图片，帮助你上幼儿园和学前班的孩子学习字母、数字和颜色。

ex.s: He cut some fur from the family cat to make a brush.
ex.t: 他从家里的猫身上剪下一些毛来做了一支画笔。

defs.def: to stop doing, using or eating sth 停止做（或使用、食用）
to make a path or passage through sth by cutting 开辟（出路或通道）

ex.s: Think of your first draft as a path cut out of the jungle—as part of an exploration, not as a complete highway.
ex.t: 把你的初稿看作从丛林中开辟出的一条路——作为探索的一部分，而不是一条完整的高速公路。

defs.def: to injure sb badly by cutting or hitting them （严重地）割伤，打伤
to upset sb emotionally 使伤心；使悲伤；使难受
a wound caused by sth sharp 伤口；划口
a hole or an opening in sth, made with sth sharp （锋利物留下的）开口，破口
a reduction in amount, size, supply, etc. （数量、尺寸、供应等的）削减，减少，缩减
an act of cutting sb's hair; the style in which it is cut 理发；发型
the shape and style that a piece of clothing has because of the way the cloth is cut （剪裁的）款式，式样
a share in sth, especially money （尤指钱的）份，份额
an act of removing part of a film/movie, play, piece of writing, etc. 删剪；删节
a piece of meat cut from an animal （从动物躯体上）割下的一块肉

ex.s: Pack a bag cut a cake, guess which juice container holds the most liquid, and much more.
ex.t: 装一个袋子、切一块蛋糕、猜猜哪个果汁容器装的水最多，还有很多其他活动。

chunks.cn: 不用于进行时 去 切
